name: ae-ssim
one_line: Autoencoder trained and scored with SSIM instead of per-pixel L2, so structural defects show up in the residual map.

key.label: SSIM autoencoder, pixel-level ROC AUC on NanoTWICE (nanofibrous materials); this paper has no MVTec AD result
key.loc: Sec. 4.3 Results text (p6): 'improves from 0.688 to 0.966'; Table 2 bold cells (d=500, K=11, patch 128x128)
key.protocol: unsupervised, defect-free training patches only; pixel-level ROC over the whole NanoTWICE test set; not MVTec AD

name: uninformed-students
one_line: Ensemble of students regresses a pretrained teacher's patch descriptors on normal images; regression error plus student variance flags anomalies.

key.label: Uninformed Students, multiscale (p=17, 33, 65 combined), MVTec AD mean normalized area under the PRO curve up to 30% FPR; no image AUROC reported
key.protocol: one-class (one model per category), full-shot; metric is AU-PRO to FPR 0.3, not AUROC

name: dn2
one_line: Plain kNN distance in ImageNet-pretrained ResNet feature space beats self-supervised anomaly detectors at image level.

key.label: DN2, CIFAR-10 one-class mean ROCAUC (%); this paper has no MVTec AD result
key.loc: Table 1 (Anomaly Detection Accuracy on Cifar10), row Avg, col DN2
key.protocol: one-class image-level (one CIFAR-10 class is normal, the rest anomalous), ImageNet-pretrained ResNet features, kNN distance; not MVTec AD

name: gaussian-ad
one_line: One multivariate Gaussian on average-pooled pretrained EfficientNet features per level; summed Mahalanobis distance scores whole images.

key.label: Mahalanobis (ours), NPCA 1%, EfficientNet-B4, MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%), SEM 1.2
key.loc: Table V, row 'Mahalanobis (ours) / NPCA 1% / EfficientNet-B4', col Mean; also abstract
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, image-level only; 5-fold evaluation over each category's training set, mean over categories and folds

name: patch-svdd
one_line: Deep SVDD trained on patches with a self-supervised position task; distance to the nearest normal patch embedding localizes defects.

key.label: Patch SVDD, MVTec AD mean image AUROC (anomaly detection)
key.loc: Table 1 left (Task: Anomaly Detection), row 'Patch SVDD (Ours)'

name: cfa
one_line: Adds a small trainable patch descriptor that pulls normal patch features toward their nearest memory-bank centers (coupled hyperspheres).

key.label: CFA++ (WRN50-2), MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)
key.loc: Table 2, row I-AUROC / All, col CFA++; also abstract
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, WRN50-2, resize 256 then center crop 224; CFA++ ensembles results on cropped and on resized-only inputs (text under Table 2)

name: pni
one_line: Memory-bank scoring conditioned on neighborhood features (an MLP) and per-position histograms; a refine net trained on synthetic defects sharpens maps.

key.label: PNI (single model, WideResNet-101), MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)
key.loc: Table 2 (v3 PDF p6), row PNI, col AUROC Image; also abstract
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, WideResNet-101, resize 512 then center crop 480

name: reconpatch
one_line: Learns a linear modulation of pretrained patch features by contrastive learning with similarity pseudo-labels, then scores PatchCore-style.

key.label: ReConPatch ensemble (WRN-101 + RNext-101 + DenseN-201), MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)
key.loc: Table 6, row Detection, col Ours (480x480); also abstract

name: differnet
one_line: Normalizing flow on pooled multi-scale AlexNet image features; image-level only, scored over several test-time transforms of each image.

key.label: DifferNet, MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%); no pixel metric
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, image-level only; AlexNet features at 3 scales (448x448, 224x224, 112x112 inputs)

name: cflow-ad
one_line: Conditional flows on each pyramid level of a frozen encoder, with positional encoding as the condition, giving per-pixel likelihoods.

key.label: CFLOW-AD (WideResNet-50), MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, WideResNet-50, per-class best hyperparameters from the ablation (input 256x256 or 512x512 per class, Table 3), mean of 4 runs

name: cs-flow
one_line: Fully convolutional flow that processes three image scales jointly with cross-scale connections, keeping the spatial layout of feature maps.

key.label: CS-Flow (full training set), MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%); no pixel metric
key.loc: Table 1, row Average, col 'CS-Flow (ours) (16 shots/full set)', second value of '93.5 98.7'
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, image-level only; EfficientNet-B5 features at 3 scales (768x768, 384x384, 192x192 inputs)

name: msflow
venue: IEEE TNNLS (under review, per PDF header)
one_line: Parallel flows per scale plus a fusion flow that exchanges information across scales; different scale aggregation for detection versus localization.

key.label: MSFlow (WRN-50), MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)
key.loc: Table I, row 'Total Average', col MSFlow; also abstract

name: nsa
one_line: Poisson-blends resized patches from other normal images into seamless fake defects; a network predicts their pixel labels end to end.

key.label: NSA (logistic), MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%), standard error 0.3 over 5 seeds
key.loc: Table 1, row 'overall average', col 'NSA (logistic)'; also abstract
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, no external data; objects resized to 256x256 with 224x224 center crop at test, textures 256x256; mean over 5 seeds

name: memseg
one_line: U-Net segmenter trained on simulated defects, with a memory of normal-image features compared against the input for guidance.

key.label: MemSeg, MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)
key.loc: Table 1 (PDF p9; no LaTeX source downloaded), row Average, col Ours, first value of '(99.56,98.84)'; also abstract

name: dsr
one_line: Samples fake anomalies from a learned quantized feature space, not image space, so near-in-distribution defects can be synthesized.

key.label: DSR, MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)

name: simplenet
one_line: Adds Gaussian noise to adapted pretrained patch features as fake anomalies; a small discriminator learns to separate them.

key.label: SimpleNet (WideResNet50), MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)
key.loc: Table 1, row Average, col SimpleNet, first value of '99.6/98.1'; also abstract
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, WideResNet50, resize 256 then center crop 224

name: glass
one_line: Feature-level fake anomalies from Gaussian noise steered by gradient ascent, plus image-level synthetic defects, to cover weak defects.

key.label: GLASS-j, MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)
key.loc: Table 1, row Average, col GLASS-j, first value of '99.9/99.3'; also abstract
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, WideResNet50 (level2 + level3), resize and center crop to 288x288; GLASS-j picks GLASS-m or GLASS-h per category by image-level spectrogram analysis

name: stpm
one_line: One student with the teacher's architecture matches the teacher's feature pyramid at several scales; pyramid differences give the anomaly map.

key.label: STPM, MVTec AD mean image AUC-ROC
key.protocol: one-class, full-shot, ResNet-18 teacher and student (conv2_x, conv3_x, conv4_x)

name: rd4ad
one_line: Reverse distillation: a student decoder rebuilds the teacher encoder's multi-scale features from a compact one-class bottleneck embedding.

key.label: Reverse Distillation (WideResNet50, 256x256), MVTec AD mean image AUROC (%)
key.loc: Table 1, row 'Total Average', last col Ours (image size 256)
